messages:
Alex: Heads-up — code freeze for v1.9.0 goes live at 17:00 UTC today. If you need a late merge, post an exception request + short risk assessment here. Changelog bump/PRs should be in by 16:30. :hourglass:
Maya: FYI PR #5482 (runtime bump) needs a docs changelog entry, I'm on it.
Devon: Requesting late exception for PR #5499 (quant-tuning). Risk: small perf tweak, validated on staging, no schema changes.
Devon: Cherry-pick I'll use:
```
git checkout release-1.9
git cherry-pick abc1234
git push origin release-1.9
```
Anil: @Devon what's the rollback strategy if rollout causes regressions?
Devon: Rollback plan: revert cherry-pick and switch model-variant back to previous quant config. Canary tested and revert time <5min.
Sarah (release-manager): Approved for exception pending QA signoff and changelog update. @Devon please open changelog PR and tag me when CI is green. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: deploy-checklist — presubmit: passed; smoke-tests: pending; infra-health: ok
Maya: Changelog PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/5500 — linked PR #5499 in description.
Sarah (release-manager): If CI green by 16:45 UTC I'll open the freeze exception and allow the merge. Keep notifications in this thread.
Devon: Running smoke tests now, ETA ~10m.
Maya: Docs updated in the changelog PR.
Devon: Smoke tests passed, CI green. Ready to proceed.
Sarah (release-manager): Late merge window opened. @Devon you may merge, but please monitor canary and report in #eng-sre for the next 30m. Tag me on anomalies. :eyes:
Alex: Quick reminder — add a one-line note in the release notes about this runtime change after merge.
Devon: Merged at 16:54 UTC. Will monitor. Thanks all. :tada:
